mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) increases risk of hypocalcemia when combined with denosumab, which also lowers serum calcium through RANKL inhibition.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, and potassium levels regularly; ensure adequate supplementation before and during denosumab therapy; assess need for loop diuretic dosage adjustment.
